purpose: Autonomously measure strong gene-expression rank associations that reproduce in two pinned independent breast-tumour cohorts, with no human labels, pair selection, threshold changes, or interpretation.

seen_before_freeze: two complete source transports and their Git LFS byte identities
source metadata, both headers, and one data row per source for parser conformance
not_seen_before_freeze: any passing or null-control pair count
freeze_boundary.disclosure: The source files were downloaded and byte-verified before freeze. Only metadata, headers, sample-column counts, and one row from each file were inspected to establish parser conformance; no cross-gene calculation was run.

candidate_universe.entity: positive Entrez Gene ids occurring exactly once in each source with the same non-empty HUGO symbol

measurement.underflow_policy: clamp p to float64 smallest positive normal before BH and export q as conservative when clamped

negative_control.preserves: each selected gene's marginal empirical distribution

publication.ordering: descending minimum absolute rho across cohorts, then ascending Entrez ids

claim_boundary.allowed_claim: a bounded rank-expression association observed in both pinned cohorts under this frozen protocol
not_a_claim_of: absence of academic or non-academic knowledge
a relation that generalizes beyond these cohorts
independence from tumour subtype, purity, batch, or cell-composition confounding

limitations: A replicated cohort-level correlation can be driven by tumour subtype, purity, batch, stromal or immune composition, copy number, or other shared causes.
Cross-platform agreement reduces platform-specific risk but does not establish a biological mechanism or cell-intrinsic regulation.
The deterministic 1,000-gene universe is a score-blind computational subset, not a representative sample of biology.
cBioPortal's pinned source metadata warns that the TCGA transport is preliminary and should be used with caution.
Academic corpora and expression cohorts omit or thinly represent non-academic, practitioner, craft, indigenous, historical, and other human knowledge.

amendments.timing: after the score-free source and candidate-universe seals but before any pairwise association, candidate ranking, passing count, or null-control count existed
amendments.trigger: The first production load encountered the source-declared string NA for selected Entrez 404217. The implementation aborted instead of applying the already-frozen missing_or_nonfinite_gene_action.
amendments.change: Parse blank, NA, and NaN cells as non-finite values so standardised_rank_rows censors the gene and every containing pair exactly as the original measurement contract requires.
unchanged: the sealed 1,000-gene universe and all 499,500 pair identities
all effect, q-value, agreement, power, and null-control thresholds

amendments.timing: after the first complete pairwise run exposed the numeric representation issue and before any result artifact was committed or published
amendments.trigger: The first complete run exported several approximate q-values as exact 0.0 after float64 underflow. The gates only require q <= 0.01, so the zeros did not affect pass decisions, but presenting them as exact values would overstate numeric evidence.
amendments.change: Clamp underflowed two-sided p-values to the float64 smallest positive normal before Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment and label every exported q-value conservative. Preserve the superseded byte-complete run off repository.
unchanged: both source byte identities and sample rows
the sealed 1,000-gene universe and all 499,500 pair identities
all effect, q-value, agreement, power, and null-control thresholds
every pair pass or censor decision and the deterministic publication ordering
